statement: Bit 5 (0x20) in the DualSense player_leds output field is source-supported as the instant-versus-fade selection: nowrep/dualsensectl ORs the instant option into bit 5 and XInput_HID explicitly describes the low bit value as fade-in and the high value as an immediate change. SDL previously used this bit. Physical transition timing and behavior across hardware revisions remain unmeasured.

applicability.revision: pinned source implementations nowrep d3ae2fa, XInput_HID 11cf2ea, yesbotics 24203b8; retail firmware and hardware revision not measured
applicability.scope: DualSense output common byte 43, bit 5; nowrep main.c 610-639, XInput_HID dualsense.cpp 177-198; SDL previously used and commented on bit 5. Source-only interpretation, not verified LED behavior.
